description:
## Background

`src/App.tsx` currently owns renderer-shell composition together with the coupled Issue Navigation and Workspace runtime: transition admission, refresh replay, startup listeners, deep links, history traversal, and Issue actions. This makes the shell the only place that understands the full orchestration protocol.

The goal is to place that behavior behind one deep `useIssueExplorerCoordinator` interface while preserving every user-visible behavior and race-handling invariant. The work must avoid temporary migration interfaces, a transport port introduced only for tests, and private hook seams that merely reproduce refs and setters.

Triage: `ready-for-agent` after its child issues are individually ready.

## What to build

Extract the Issue Explorer runtime from `App`, first establishing missing behavior contracts and resolving the pre-existing refresh-health identity bug. Then mechanically move the orchestration behind the final coordinator interface and consolidate accepted presentation publication.

## Technical Approach

This epic is delivered through dependent child issues. The dependency graph will be updated with the created child IDs. The mechanical coordinator extraction must remain separate from presentation-state cleanup so regressions can be attributed to one change at a time.

## Considerations

- Preserve subscription-first listener registration and serial registration order.
- Preserve stale-generation and confirmed-Workspace-path guards.
- Preserve navigation-intent supersession across manual selection, deep links, and history traversal.
- Preserve `data-workspace-key` semantics without introducing a React `key`.
- Keep invalid-view canonicalization before the authoritative Issue Navigation state write.
- Keep Settings as a replacement route while retaining its underlying Issue Navigation Entry.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All child issues are closed in dependency order.
- [ ] `App` owns only renderer-shell routing/canonicalization, settings, sidebar state, and JSX composition concerns.
- [ ] The coordinator interface exposes no refs, state setters, gate decisions, deferred payloads, or raw listeners.
- [ ] Existing user-visible behavior and copy remain unchanged except for the separately approved refresh-health bug fix.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass at completion.

## Test Plan

- Preserve and extend App-level integration coverage for Workspace, refresh, navigation, deep-link, Settings, and StrictMode lifecycle behavior.
- Keep transition-gate truth-table coverage in its existing pure tests.
- Run `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` after the final child.
title: Extract the Issue Explorer coordinator from App
